topics.title: Exclude archived agents from nest and order regeneration

entries.title: Exclude archived agents from nest and order regeneration
entries.rationale: Accept as security-gated archive and regeneration hardening, but do not carry forward upstream's fail-open roster behavior. Zion adaptation must treat an unavailable or unverifiable archival snapshot as non-authoritative, prevent stale archived agents from being presented as active/actionable, preserve one captured relay target, and retain latest-requested-wins generation ordering and monotonic snapshot publication.
security_reasons: archived identity state controls which managed agents are presented as active
upstream fail-open behavior can expose stale archived agents during relay failure
NIP-11 signer and archive snapshot must be bound to one captured relay target
generation ordering prevents stale roster writes after newer requests
relay-signed archival snapshot replacement must converge under concurrent archive/unarchive mutations

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after archive/roster threat review, fail-closed or non-authoritative failure semantics, relay-target binding tests, concurrent snapshot tests, generation-order tests, dependency screening, and Zion branding/compatibility checks.

verification: Full-SHA relay/archive/nest diff, trust boundary, failure semantics, concurrency gates, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
